                   token | tunnel | tuntap | vrf | xfrm }
       OPTIONS := { -V[ersion] | -s[tatistics] | -d[etails] | -r[esolve] |
                    -h[uman-readable] | -iec | -j[son] | -p[retty] |
                    -f[amily] { inet | inet6 | mpls | bridge | link } |
                    -4 | -6 | -M | -B | -0 |
                    -l[oops] { maximum-addr-flush-attempts } | -br[ief] |
                    -o[neline] | -t[imestamp] | -ts[hort] | -b[atch] [filename] |
                    -rc[vbuf] [size] | -n[etns] name | -N[umeric] | -a[ll] |
                    -c[olor]}

root@a2b7ad2f6e6c:/app# roqet --help
Rasqal RDF query utility
0.9.33

Run an RDF query against data into formatted results.
Usage: roqet [OPTIONS] <query URI> [base URI]
       roqet [OPTIONS] -e <query string> [base URI]
       roqet [OPTIONS] -p <SPARQL protocol URI> <query URI> [base URI]
       roqet [OPTIONS] -p <SPARQL protocol URI> -e <query string> [base URI]
       roqet [OPTIONS] -t <query results file> [base URI]

Copyright (C) 2003-2014 David Beckett - http://www.dajobe.org/
Copyright (C) 2003-2005 University of Bristol - http://www.bristol.ac.uk/
License: LGPL 2.1 or newer, GPL 2 or newer, Apache 2.0 or newer.
See http://librdf.org/rasqal/LICENSE.html for full terms.
Rasqal home page: http://librdf.org/rasqal/

Normal operation is to execute the query retrieved from URI <query URI>
and print the results in a simple text format.

Main options:
  -e, --exec QUERY        Execute QUERY string instead of <query URI>
  -p, --protocol URI      Execute QUERY against a SPARQL protocol service URI
  -i, --input LANGUAGE    Set query language name to one of:
    sparql10                SPARQL 1.0 W3C RDF Query Language (default)
    sparql                  SPARQL 1.1 (DRAFT) Query and Update Languages
    sparql11-query          SPARQL 1.1 (DRAFT) Query Language
    sparql11-update         SPARQL 1.1 (DRAFT) Update Language
    laqrs                   LAQRS adds to Querying RDF in SPARQL
  -r, --results FORMAT    Set query results output format to one of:
    For variable bindings and boolean results:
      simple                A simple text format (default)
      xml                   SPARQL XML Query Results
      json                  SPARQL JSON Query Results
      table                 Table
      csv                   Comma Separated Values (CSV)
      mkr                   mKR relation (mkr)
      tsv                   Tab Separated Values (TSV)
      html                  HTML Table
      turtle                Turtle Query Results
      rdfxml                RDF/XML Query Results
    For RDF graph results:
      rdfxml                RDF/XML (default)
      ntriples              N-Triples
      turtle                Turtle Terse RDF Triple Language
      trig                  TriG - Turtle with Named Graphs
      rss-tag-soup          RSS Tag Soup
      grddl                 Gleaning Resource Descriptions from Dialects of Languages
      guess                 Pick the parser to use using content type and URI
      rdfa                  RDF/A via librdfa
      json                  RDF/JSON (either Triples or Resource-Centric)
      nquads                N-Quads
  -t, --results FILE      Read query results from a FILE
  -R, --results-input-format FORMAT
                          Set input query results format to one of:
      xml                   SPARQL XML Query Results (default)
      csv                   Comma Separated Values (CSV)
      mkr                   mKR relation (mkr)
      tsv                   Tab Separated Values (TSV)
      turtle                Turtle Query Results
      rdfxml                RDF/XML Query Results

Additional options:
  -c, --count             Count triples - no output
  -d FORMAT, --dump-query FORMAT
                          Print the parsed query out in FORMAT:
      none                  No debug data
      debug                 Debug query dump (output format may change)
      structure             Query structure walk (output format may change)
      sparql                SPARQL
  -D URI, --data URI      RDF data source URI
  -E, --ignore-errors     Ignore error messages
  -f FEATURE(=VALUE), --feature FEATURE(=VALUE)
                          Set query features
                            Use `-f help' for a list of valid features
  -F NAME, --format NAME  Set data source format name (default: guess)
  -G URI, --named URI     RDF named graph data source URI
  -h, --help              Print this help, then exit
  -n, --dryrun            Prepare but do not run the query
  -q, --quiet             No extra information messages
  -s URI, --source URI    Same as `-G URI'
  -v, --version           Print the Rasqal version
  -W LEVEL, --warnings LEVEL
                          Set warning message LEVEL from 0: none to 100: all

DEBUG options:
      --store-results BOOL  Set store results yes/no BOOL

Report bugs to http://bugs.librdf.org/
